supersession_reason: Development-only force/contact audits found that V2 used a world-frame smoke oracle after moving ejection into the randomized hole frame, an asymmetric held-out force magnitude, and an uncompensated blocker servo that could drift before onset. V3 fixes the smoke oracle, uses matched 1.7 N hole-frame impulses, and calibrates force-only blocker station-keeping and return on 421M development seeds. No router production outcome, numerical method threshold, selection seed, or confirmation seed was opened or changed.
purpose: Close the external-validity blocker independently of the LearnedRecovery-v4 primary gate.

task.execution_rule: All runtime object motion and insertion use simulator forces, contacts, and robot actions; pose assignment is permitted only at reset.

physics_calibration.smoke_contract: Accumulate safety violations over the full 160-step episode; measure ejection displacement in the randomized hole frame; require at least 90% ejection observability, blocker engagement, and temporary clearance, with at most 10% zero-action ejection violations.

interventions.heldout_real_trajectory_rule: Every real negative-ejection prefix is excluded from training and validation and reserved for test.
interventions.counterfactual_direction_supervision: The physical ejection force and all relative vectors use each episode's randomized hole frame. Reflect local lateral-y coordinates of positive-ejection prefixes. These paired tensors supervise event/readiness/direction factors only; option-2 cross-entropy is masked.

method_contract.group_rule: Factual and reflected prefixes share an episode group; all real held-out groups are test-only.

outcomes.feasible_conditions: Native PegInsertionSide success without a safety violation.
outcomes.permanently_infeasible_condition: Calibrated safe abstention after physical obstruction, with no protected-region collision; oracle mechanism state is used only for scoring.

release_rule: An A/A+ method claim requires both the LearnedRecovery-v4 gate and this external task-family gate to pass.
